label: prf:q-heat-equation-exists
title: Proof of existence and uniqueness for the $q$-heat equation
html:
Proof. Proof of existence and uniqueness for the q-heat equation

Formal solution: u(t) = \exp(-t \Delta_q) u_0 = \sum_{n \ge 0} \frac{(-t \Delta_q)^n}{n!} u_0, which lives in \mathrm{End}(\mathcal{S}) \otimes u_0 as a formal power series in t. On Peter--Weyl isotypic components \pi_j(u_0), the solution is the eigenfunction expansion u(t) = \sum_j e^{-\lambda_j(q) t} \pi_j(u_0) (Peter--Weyl heat kernel), which is a finite sum on each irrep summand and therefore exists categorically without convergence hypotheses. Over \mathbb{C} the sum converges to a smooth solution; over \mathbb{F}_p, \mathbb{Q}_p the formal sum has the same categorical meaning.
